base_rules: Sockets: Larzuk quest (Act 5 Normal) adds sockets to a non-socketed normal base; Act 5 sockets: shield 4, armor up to 3 or 4; helm 3? Use whatever the item max sockets (see itemtypes.txt/ armor.txt)
For early Spirit: buy a Crystal Sword/ Broad Sword and a Monarch (Hell) shield; normal-quality, 4 sockets; rare/magic won't work
Stealth needs armor with 2 sockets: Hell armors, Studded Leather etc.; Larzuk can add 2 in Normal on armor with max sockets 2+
